masteryZone.q: The geographical term 'Saptasindhu' mentioned in the Rigveda refers to:
masteryZone.sol: Saptasindhu represents the Land of Seven Rivers: Indus and its five tributaries plus Sarasvati.

masteryZone.q: True or False: The center of Vedic civilization remained stationary in Punjab throughout both Early and Later Vedic periods.
masteryZone.sol: False. It shifted eastward into the fertile Gangetic plain during the Later Vedic period.

masteryZone.q: Which Veda contains the Satapatha Brahmana, detailing rituals and agrarian rites?
masteryZone.sol: The Satapatha Brahmana is part of the Yajurveda (Shukla Yajurveda).

masteryZone.q: Fill in the blank: The philosophical dialogues concerning the soul (Atman) and absolute reality (Brahman) are compiled in the ________.
masteryZone.sol: Upanishads (or Vedanta) are the peak of Vedic philosophical inquiry.

masteryZone.q: Under Later Vedic polity, what was the primary duty of the officer called 'Sangrihitri'?
masteryZone.sol: The Sangrihitri was the treasurer / custodian of the royal treasury.

masteryZone.q: True or False: Women were barred from attending the Sabha assembly in the Later Vedic Period.
masteryZone.sol: True. While women attended assemblies in the Rigvedic period, they lost this right in the Later Vedic era.

masteryZone.q: Which of the following gods became supreme in the Later Vedic period, replacing Indra?
masteryZone.sol: Prajapati (the Creator) became the supreme god in the Later Vedic period.
